title: Unique Friend | TiMotion AI CEO: Building Marketing Agents That Actually Understand Marketing
summary: Product: Enterprise AIGC marketing-agent platform — multimodal creative gen, marketing search, digital-employee workflow orchestration. Scenes: brand ad creative, sentiment monitoring/guidance, market/product/consumer insight, digital employees, internal training, knowledge
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Unique Friend Q&A · October 12, 2024 · Guest: CEO, TiMotion AI (钛镁AI)

Product: Enterprise AIGC marketing-agent platform — multimodal creative gen, marketing search, digital-employee workflow orchestration. Scenes: brand ad creative, sentiment monitoring/guidance, market/product/consumer insight, digital employees, internal training, knowledge bases. Positioning: “the agent that understands marketing.”

Differentiation: (1) Deep marketing vertical + project-hardened methodology + multi-dimensional marketing corpora. (2) Platform-grade (not a single tool) covering nearly the full marketing chain. (3) Beyond SaaS: private model deploy + self-built knowledge-graph–enhanced Prompt framework + responsive middleware for industry-specific fine-tunes.

GenAI impact: Faster creative divergence (copy, posters, product shoots); automated persona-fit ads/email/social/seeding; marketing search refines campaigns from behavior/feedback. Pricing: digital employees for dynamic pricing from supply/demand/competitors/behavior + personalized price by history/sensitivity.

Tech lead: Ongoing basic-research spend with universities; domain experts + ~20 years marketing depth; large high-quality datasets; customer feedback loops + A/B tests.

Ecosystem: Application-layer agent vendor — open, win-win partnerships with model vendors and up/downstream; often co-deliver full solutions for specific B-side scenes.

Challenges: Cross-discipline talent shortage; mismatched expectations — GenAI helps but is not “omnipotent”; today’s outputs still reflect developer priors — managing client expectations and educating the market is hard. Global: U.S./Europe still lead research; China has policy + local-scene speed and rising tech acceptance.

2024 watch: Video models fit for ad/marketing landing; voice-search / screenless brand recognition as speakers and voice assistants scale.

— END —
